rule: the I = 0 members of the J^PC = 1++ and 1+- nonets, whose I = 1 members a1(1260) and b1(1235) the catalog carries: f1(1285) at its PDG 2024 mass, width and every mode of at least 1% (4pi 32.7%, eta pi pi 52.2%, K Kbar pi 9.0%, gamma rho0 6.1%, the multi-body modes through their three-body final states and charge splits by isospin), h1(1170) through rho pi; the b1(1235)0 record as the template (J = 1, P = +), I = 0; beside every continuum class of an omega and a pion the classes with the f1(1285) and the h1(1170) in the omega's place, the isospin factors deciding the charges; eta(1295) lists no fractions and stays out
